# SECOND LIFE / UNHALT

Selected visual direction: SECOND LIFE, user choice 2026-10-06. Hero/logo/banner: original built-in ImageGen artwork. Visual memory metaphor, not live agent telemetry.

UI fonts self-hosted: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope via official Google Fonts distribution; OFL licenses bundled. Sources: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope

Utility icons: Phosphor Icons regular, MIT license bundled. Source https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core
